set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM surface-view-javafx; consumer PLS Neuro viewer, /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro, local integration bd-01M1YEC2V9X0K7KF8SN321VR82. Reuse native c14b36a semantic work; this is a newly reproduced legacy varying-color cortical presentation defect, not a claim that all certified scalar paths fail.

Observed native JavaFX24.0.1 display of274513-vertex real FreeSurfer cortex has pervasive fine speckling in lit and unlit varying-color areas. Native camera/depth backport repairs clipping and overlap; constant-face zero-derivative UV backport cleans constant gray patches but does not resolve variable-face regions. Consumer evidence output/brain-display/inflated-{9,10}; exact provider candidate2 af5c235466be1f0dde445a73eba45ee76456f06e9733c45a49ef995c66c3ff7c on fd992a0, native source provenance c14b36a. Current main full scalar/fragment engine has broader contracts; do not silently switch interpolation semantics.

Exact OpenJFX24.0.1 ES2PhongMaterial source enables mipmaps for diffuse/self-illumination maps on nonembedded platforms. A source-identical control and one-line no-mipmap diagnostic class compile; hidden native A/B is pending. Source/archive/compile hashes in /private/tmp/plsneuro-openjfx-mipmap-diagnostic-1. This is a diagnostic fork only, not approved production dependency policy.

Acceptance: isolate cause through public ScalaFIM render APIs and controlled framebuffer comparison; repair in native renderer or propose a narrow explicit upstream OpenJFX capability if public APIs cannot express the required filtering. Preserve scientific vertex/face IDs, interpolation/threshold/opacity, picks and mapped values. Check lit/unlit, minification/magnification, oblique views, dense real cortex and dynamic palette/threshold/lighting updates. Measure latency/allocations; do not blur/average statistical fields to hide artifacts. Native required-platform/conformance and PLS Neuro consumer evidence must be bound to exact candidate. Full scalar approximation may be evaluated but its error/resource envelope must remain explicit. No mesh4s defect established.

Independent issue: old consumer fixture nonlinearly warped already-inflated display coordinates; replacing it with original FreeSurfer display geometry while leaving MNI sampling intact. That presentation-data correction is application fixture/resource work, not evidence of a native transform kernel bug.
set.title: Remove cross-face texture contamination in JavaFX cortical surface display
